Description: Initialize analysis and discovery runtime layouts
ExpectedBehavior: Runtime zones and guards are created before stage execution

Description: Reject non-orchestrator canonical writes
ExpectedBehavior: Canonical write attempts by workers are blocked and logged

Description: Promote artifacts through lock-based merge
ExpectedBehavior: Promotion occurs only with lock and marker prerequisites

Description: Validate discovery to main source+excerpt dedup on Stage 1 intake
ExpectedBehavior: Discovery S-xxx/E-xxx are reused by Stage 1 intake when (SourceType, Origin, Title) or (SourceID, Locator) match; source_reused and excerpt_reused merge_log events are emitted with resolution=informational

Description: Validate discovery claim lineage propagation into main A59
ExpectedBehavior: Every discovery D-C-xxx claim reaching discovery.go is carried into main A59 with renumbered C-yyy identifier, preserved DiscoveryLineage column, Provenance=discovery-promoted, and a claim_lineage merge_log event

Description: Validate conflict detection blocks promotion
ExpectedBehavior: A claim_conflict or excerpt_text_conflict event raises an A51 row with IssueType=contradiction, BlockingStatus=hard, RaisedByStage=stage1; Stage 1 promotion is halted until the A51 row is manually resolved; merge_log entry carries resolution=hard_blocked and a51_ref

Description: Validate soft tier-mismatch resolution
ExpectedBehavior: When a source matches by identity tuple but carries different ReliabilityTier between discovery and main A50, a source_tier_mismatch merge_log event is emitted with resolution=soft_resolved; higher tier wins; no A51 is raised; promotion continues

Description: Enforce evidence-binding on promotion
ExpectedBehavior: Promotion fails when ClaimID or A51Ref traceability is missing

Description: Enforce D0 to BSA bridge markers
ExpectedBehavior: Stage 1 entry is blocked without discovery.go and bsa.stage1.entry.enabled

Description: Validate Stage 1 to Stage 3 evidence and semantic contracts
ExpectedBehavior: Claim-layer and semantic outputs meet contract gates

Description: Validate Stage 2 required artifact set presence and shape
ExpectedBehavior: All five Stage 2 proposal artifacts exist with shape-valid content

Description: Validate Stage 2 required headers and column schemas
ExpectedBehavior: Required sections in context_state_frame and system_context_seed plus required columns in stakeholder_authority_map and constraints_dependencies_route are present and evidence-cited

Description: Validate Stage 2 summary fields and analyst_judgment discipline
ExpectedBehavior: stage2_summary.json carries all required fields and digests; any ClaimType=analyst_judgment row authored under Stage 2 has non-empty JustificationRationale referencing an upstream ClaimID different from its own

Description: Validate Stage 4 to Stage 6 modeling and anchor contracts
ExpectedBehavior: Path-aligned artifacts and A61-ready anchors are auditable

Description: Validate Stage 7 to Stage 8 readiness and handoff
ExpectedBehavior: Readiness and handoff outputs pass mandatory gate set

Description: Validate H1 executive brief shape and citation closure
ExpectedBehavior: H1_exec_brief.md has all five required sections, ≤ 2-page compression, and every statement resolves to A59 ClaimID / analyst_judgment with valid JustificationRationale / A51Ref

Description: Validate H2 delivery packet shape and anchor closure
ExpectedBehavior: H2_delivery_packet.md has all seven required sections and every anchor ID resolves to canonical A61 map; FR/NFR/contract rows resolve to canonical registers

Description: Validate H3 validation packet KPI roll-up consistency
ExpectedBehavior: H3_validation_packet.md has all five required sections including non-empty Test Scenario Seed placeholder; KPI Scorecard numbers match canonical audit reports and marker timestamps

Description: Validate H4 open items coverage and analyst_judgment discipline
ExpectedBehavior: H4_open_items_packet.md has all five required sections; every non-closed A51 row is present; every [AJ:C-xxx] tag resolves to an A59 analyst_judgment row with non-empty JustificationRationale referencing at least one upstream ClaimID different from its own

Description: Validate D1 governance framing outputs
ExpectedBehavior: Problem framing remains discovery-only and governance-bound

Description: Validate D2 research and discovery claim layer
ExpectedBehavior: Research outputs and discovery A58/A59/A60 are contract-complete

Description: Validate D3 and D4 prioritization and feasibility
ExpectedBehavior: Prioritization and feasibility outputs satisfy pass criteria

Description: Validate D5 synthesis and decision artifacts
ExpectedBehavior: Discovery synthesis and decision package are complete and governed

Description: Validate aggregate discovery branch behavior
ExpectedBehavior: Discovery branch remains subordinate and bridge-safe

Description: Validate single-writer governance and lifecycle rules
ExpectedBehavior: No parallel governance ledgers and consistent lifecycle markers

Description: Validate sidecar derived-only integration
ExpectedBehavior: Sidecars remain non-canonical and anchor-mapped
